name: Ink Marbling
desc: Full-bleed suminagashi where concentric ink drops bloom, comb strokes shear the pattern, and a slow curl current advects the whole marble across the paper.

style.doc: render philosophy: muted natural inks on cream / vivid Turkish ebru / iridescent oil-on-water / pure ink-line topography (non-representational) / black-and-white sumi

act.doc: multi-minute dramaturgy: steady drifting swirl / frequent comb passes / rapid drop blooming
